srep-0036-geo-outline-p125.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<assets><geo id="sq" src="../assets/srep36-squares.geojson"/><map id="m-sq" width="640" height="360" projection="equirectangular" fit="sq" fitPadding="20"><geoLayer geo="sq" fill="#00000000" stroke="#00FF00FF" strokeWidth="4" progress="0.125"/></map></assets>
<composition>
<layer id="atlas" asset="m-sq" x="0" y="0"/>
</composition>
</scene>

expected.pending: the specification states no stroke cap for geoLayer (geoLayerType has no strokeCap; SREP 36 says only that each ring is traced through the same trim as shapes), and these values assume butt ends. Measured on scene-render 0.5.0 (commit 12ede1e, binary sha256 prefix 6998aafaa03f738e, prod VM, 2026-10-12): green cx 190.89, cy 221.46, w 504, h 104. Derivation: at progress 0.125 square a traces 100 px of its first edge and square b 50 px, 500 px apart; with butt ends cx = 20 + 500*50/150 = 186.67 (the value here), with square ends of half the 4 px stroke the lengths are 104 and 54, cx = 20 + 500*54/158 = 190.89 and h = 104, which is what the engine draws. Left pending until the schema states the cap of a traced geo outline The same values (cx 190.89, cy 221.46, w 504, h 104) are measured on scene-render main e586b57 (0.7.4, binary sha256 prefix b7285fa1d0fba26f, llvmpipe, 2026-10-24), after its fix of a crash on this case.
